old_caption: The video captures a fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with a burst of white sparks with some orange streaks, creating an explosion. As the first burst fades, another burst emerges, primarily pink/magenta with blue and white streaks. The fireworks continue to explode in various colors and patterns, transitioning to a large multi-colored burst that includes green, then fade into remnants of sparks. A small red light remains visible in the upper right for a significant portion of the display.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display against a dark night sky. The sequence begins with a burst of red and white sparks, creating a dazzling explosion that illuminates the surrounding area. As the first burst fades, another burst emerges, this time predominantly red with hints of blue and green, adding a dynamic contrast to the scene. The fireworks continue to explode in various colors and patterns, each burst more spectacular than the last. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the fireworks as they light up the night sky, capturing the sheer beauty and energy of the display. The final frames show a burst of red and white, followed by a burst of green and white, before the display gradually subsides into a series of smaller, lingering sparks.
caption: The video captures a night-sky fireworks display against a black background, where a small white-gold starburst is already partly expanded near the bottom-center, faint sparks scattered above. A magenta burst blooms at the upper-left, growing into a shell of pink streaks whose tips become glowing dots, overlapping the gold burst below. The pink shell's streaks dim into discrete dots as it fades, leaving the gold burst brighter before it dims. A new white-gold burst erupts at the left-center, expanding into a glittering starburst with small white clusters spreading right and downward. The glittering field shifts from gold and white to green, sparkling dots dominating the left and center while a red dot persists on the right. The green dots thin out as the scene darkens, a bright white dot drifting toward the lower-right while a smoke plume lingers at the lower-left, tinted pink then green.
